rustOnly.intents: Rust workflow admission reuses a normalizer that validates nested intent cwd; agents.spawn executes only one plan. Desktop batch intents belong to fleetWorkflows.request, outside spawn.
rustOnly.projectCwd: Rust coordinator explicitly removes the supplied root before deriving project identity; desktop inner handler never destructures a supplied projectCwd and derives it from requested execution cwd.
rustOnly.remoteOrigin: Rust ordinary trace sees origin refusal and authenticated federation admission; desktop inner local handler has no remoteOrigin claim. Federation middleware is reviewed separately.
rustOnly.targetHub: Rust explicitly refuses this incomplete local selector. Desktop selects remote execution only through executionTarget=paired and remoteCwd, leaving targetHub unused.
rustOnly.workflowReservationToken: Rust explicitly removes caller tokens and generates an owned workflow admission token; desktop owns workflowBusy/task admission rather than accepting this root.

desktopOnly.pluginTools: Desktop inner DTO retains the ignored local compatibility list. Rust ordinary plan does not consume it; paired adapter separately rejects local process configuration on both implementations.
desktopOnly.profileGranted: Desktop DTO retains this obsolete grant stamp without passing authority to the spawner. Rust admission removes it before the ordinary registered launch trace.
desktopOnly.remoteCwd: Desktop inner handler forwards this value to spawnPairedWorker. Rust reads it in the authenticated Paired adapter before ordinary local spawn; both support the paired directory selection.
desktopOnly.yoloGranted: Desktop DTO retains this legacy stamp, but current permission choice uses live skipPermissions/mode and host policy. Rust admission removes the stamp before ordinary plan tracing.

targetHub.reason: Incomplete local remote selector is refused; paired execution uses its complete admission adapter.

workflowReservationToken.reason: Caller claim discarded; project identity and workflow lease are generated by the owning launch operation.
